text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 63 से 66 तक नाटक ‘The White Visitor’ पढ़ो। फिर जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 63 se 66 tak naatak ‘The White Visitor’ padho. Phir jawab do.
text.en: Read the play ‘The White Visitor’ on pages 63 to 66 of your book. Then answer.

steps.question: Why did Dr. Dass need to buy a house?

questionMeaning.hi: डॉ. दास को घर क्यों ख़रीदना था?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Dr. Dass ko ghar kyon khareedna tha?

options: He had come to live and work in Kali Ghat.
He wanted to sell it later.
His old house was haunted.
steps.answer: He had come to live and work in Kali Ghat.
steps.modelAnswer: Dr. Dass needed a house because he had come to live and work in Kali Ghat.

modelMeaning.hi: डॉ. दास को घर चाहिए था क्योंकि वे काली घाट में रहने और काम करने आए थे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Dr. Dass ko ghar chahiye tha kyonki woh Kali Ghat mein rehne aur kaam karne aaye the.

steps.question: Why did he want to buy Shanti Bhawan?

questionMeaning.hi: वे शांति भवन क्यों ख़रीदना चाहते थे?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Woh Shanti Bhawan kyon khareedna chahte the?

options: It was cheap and in the middle of the town.
It had a big garden.
Mr. Choudhary told him to buy it.
steps.answer: It was cheap and in the middle of the town.
steps.modelAnswer: He wanted to buy Shanti Bhawan because it was cheap, only three lakh, and it was in the middle of the town.

modelMeaning.hi: वे शांति भवन ख़रीदना चाहते थे क्योंकि वह सस्ता था, सिर्फ़ तीन लाख का, और शहर के बीच में था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Woh Shanti Bhawan khareedna chahte the kyonki woh sasta tha, sirf teen laakh ka, aur shahar ke beech mein tha.

steps.question: What reason did Mr. Choudhary give Dr. Dass so that he wouldn't buy Shanti Bhawan?

questionMeaning.hi: चौधरी ने डॉ. दास को शांति भवन न ख़रीदने का क्या कारण बताया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Choudhary ne Dr. Dass ko Shanti Bhawan na khareedne ka kya kaaran bataaya?

options: He said Mrs Ghosh's ghost visits the house at night.
He said the house was broken.
He said the house was very costly.
steps.answer: He said Mrs Ghosh's ghost visits the house at night.
steps.modelAnswer: Mr. Choudhary said there were strange stories about the house. People said the dead owner, Mrs Ghosh, came back at night to visit it.

modelMeaning.hi: चौधरी ने कहा कि घर के बारे में अजीब कहानियाँ हैं। लोग कहते हैं कि मरी हुई मालकिन श्रीमती घोष रात को घर आती हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Choudhary ne kaha ki ghar ke baare mein ajeeb kahaaniyaan hain. Log kehte hain ki mari hui maalkin Shrimati Ghosh raat ko ghar aati hain.

steps.question: Why did Dr. Dass want to spend a night in the house before buying it?

questionMeaning.hi: डॉ. दास ख़रीदने से पहले घर में एक रात क्यों बिताना चाहते थे?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Dr. Dass khareedne se pehle ghar mein ek raat kyon bitaana chahte the?

options: To find out if the ghost stories were true.
Because he had no other place.
To meet Mr. Ghosh.
steps.answer: To find out if the ghost stories were true.
steps.modelAnswer: Dr. Dass wanted to spend a night there to find out the truth about the ghost stories. He did not believe in them.

modelMeaning.hi: डॉ. दास भूत की कहानियों का सच जानने के लिए वहाँ रात बिताना चाहते थे। वे उन पर विश्वास नहीं करते थे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Dr. Dass bhoot ki kahaaniyon ka sach jaanne ke liye wahan raat bitaana chahte the. Woh un par vishwaas nahi karte the.

steps.question: Who was the ‘White Visitor’?
options: Mr. Choudhary
Mrs Ghosh's ghost
Mr. Ghosh
steps.modelAnswer: The White Visitor was Mr. Choudhary. Dr. Dass suspected him, so he said, "Mr. Choudhary, I believe," as soon as he pulled off the cloth.

modelMeaning.hi: सफ़ेद मेहमान चौधरी थे। डॉ. दास को उन पर पहले से शक था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Safed mehmaan Choudhary the. Dr. Dass ko un par pehle se shak tha.

steps.question: What qualities of Dr. Dass helped him in buying the house?

questionMeaning.hi: डॉ. दास के किन गुणों ने घर ख़रीदने में मदद की?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Dr. Dass ke kin gunon ne ghar khareedne mein madad ki?

options: He was brave, smart and did not believe in ghosts.
He was rich and lazy.
He was afraid and quiet.
steps.answer: He was brave, smart and did not believe in ghosts.
steps.modelAnswer: Dr. Dass was brave, smart and determined. He did not believe in ghosts, so he found out the truth.

modelMeaning.hi: डॉ. दास बहादुर, समझदार और पक्के इरादे वाले थे। वे भूतों पर विश्वास नहीं करते थे, इसलिए उन्होंने सच पता कर लिया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Dr. Dass bahaadur, samajhdaar aur pakke iraade waale the. Woh bhooton par vishwaas nahi karte the, isliye unhone sach pata kar liya.

steps.question: Why did Mr. Choudhary ask Dr. Dass not to talk about this incident?

questionMeaning.hi: चौधरी ने डॉ. दास से इस घटना के बारे में किसी को न बताने को क्यों कहा?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Choudhary ne Dr. Dass se is ghatna ke baare mein kisi ko na bataane ko kyon kaha?

options: He was afraid he would lose his business.
He was ashamed of his white cloth.
He wanted to keep the house.
steps.answer: He was afraid he would lose his business.
steps.modelAnswer: Mr. Choudhary asked him not to tell anyone because he would lose his business.

modelMeaning.hi: चौधरी ने किसी को न बताने को कहा क्योंकि उनका कारोबार चौपट हो जाता।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Choudhary ne kisi ko na bataane ko kaha kyonki unka kaarobaar chaupat ho jaata.
